#@ requires 1 == 1
    #@ ensures \result != ""
    #@ assigns \nothing
    def _handle_arraylen_expr(
        self,
        expr: Dict[str, Any],
        local_refs: Set[str],
        invariant_ctx: bool,
        subst: Optional[Dict[str, str]],
    ) -> str:
        if self.memory_model in ("hoare", "concurrent"):
            var = expr['var']
            deref = "!" if var in local_refs else ""
            return f"(length {deref}{var})"
        return f"{expr['var']}_len"
